Name: UI Info Suite 2 Redux
Author: Ekysoh
Description:
A rework of UI Info Suite 2 designed to be compatible with mods not supported by the original mod or the Android version. Original code is based off Cdaragorn's and Annosz's work.

[i]If you use [color=#f1c232][b]Cinderbox[/b][/color], this is a part of the [b]Cinderbox Pack[/b] file that can be downloaded during setup and on the Home screen.[/i]

[line]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Features[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Full mobile support with adjustable UI scaling.[/*]
[*]Rearrangeable HUD: click/tap and drag Health and Energy bars, experience bars, buffs, icons, notifications, and toolbars anywhere on the screen.[/*]
[*]Support for SpaceCore custom skills.[/*]
[*]Inspect mode for CinderTap and Tap-to-Move.[/*]
[*]Social page tracking for daily gifts and conversations.[/*]
[*]Icons for festivals, legendary fish, the Bookseller, Traveling Cart bundle items, and wedding or anniversary dates.[/*]
[*]Quest Tracker.[/*]
[*]Inline tooltips showing machines, loved gifts, and item details.[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Setup[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Open the in-game options and click the tab with the hammer icon at the end.[/*]
[*]You can select [b]Rearrange HUD[/b] to drag and place UI elements wherever you want them.[/*]
[*]Choose which features you'd like to use.[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]PC[/b]: Download the file and extract it into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*][b]Cinderbox[/b]: This is a part of the [b]Cinderbox Pack[/b] file that can be downloaded during setup and on the Home screen. You don't need to download from here.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI for Android[/b]: Download the file and install it with your launcher's Mod Manager. Please do not extract it manually.[/*]
[/list]‎‎
[line]
‎
‎For quick support, please join the [url=https://discord.gg/cinderbox-1464708507923124264][b]Cinderbox Discord server[/b][/url].
